mapper.select:
WITH a AS (SELECT DISTINCT CARD_CODE FROM ALERT_EVENT WHERE CARD_CODE IS NOT NULL AND CATEGORY <> 'OTHER' AND LAST_OCCURRED_AT >= #{activeSince} AND OCCURRED_AT >= #{activeDayStart}) SELECT w.CARD_CODE, p.PERSON_NAME, p.DEPT, ar.AREA_NAME, w.STATION_CODE, st.STATION_NAME VENDOR_NAME, m.DISPLAY_NAME, sar.AREA_NAME STATION_AREA_NAME, m.X, m.Y, w.SRC_DATA_TIME POS_TIME, CASE WHEN d.IMEI IS NULL THEN 'UNBOUND' WHEN d.LAST_SEEN_AT >= #{onlineSince} THEN 'ONLINE' ELSE 'OFFLINE' END WATCH_STATE, CASE WHEN a.CARD_CODE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ALERTING FROM V_POS_IN_WELL w LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = w.CARD_CODE LEFT JOIN POS_AREA ar ON ar.AREA_CODE = w.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN POS_STATION st ON st.STATION_CODE = w.STATION_CODE LEFT JOIN POS_AREA sar ON sar.AREA_CODE = SUBSTR(w.STATION_CODE, 1, 16) LEFT JOIN POS_STATION_MARK m ON m.STATION_CODE = w.STATION_CODE LEFT JOIN DEVICE d ON d.CARD_CODE = w.CARD_CODE AND d.STATUS = 1 LEFT JOIN a ON a.CARD_CODE = w.CARD_CODE
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM WATCH_LIST l WHERE l.CARD_CODE = w.CARD_CODE AND l.LIST_TYPE = #{list} AND (l.LIST_TYPE = 'KEY' OR l.EXPIRE_DATE >= #{today}))
AND (INSTR(p.PERSON_NAME, #{keyword}) > 0 OR INSTR(w.CARD_CODE, #{keyword}) > 0)
ORDER BY p.PERSON_NAME, w.CARD_CODE

SELECT p.CARD_CODE, p.PERSON_NAME, p.DEPT, CASE WHEN w.CARD_CODE IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END IN_WELL, ar.AREA_NAME, w.STATION_CODE, st.STATION_NAME VENDOR_NAME, m.DISPLAY_NAME, sar.AREA_NAME STATION_AREA_NAME, st.RUN_STATUS, m.X, m.Y, w.SRC_DATA_TIME POS_TIME, w.STATION_ENTER_TIME, d.IMEI, d.LAST_SEEN_AT, d.BATTERY_PCT, d.BATTERY_TIME FROM POS_PERSON p LEFT JOIN V_POS_IN_WELL w ON w.CARD_CODE = p.CARD_CODE LEFT JOIN POS_AREA ar ON ar.AREA_CODE = w.AREA_CODE LEFT JOIN POS_STATION st ON st.STATION_CODE = w.STATION_CODE LEFT JOIN POS_AREA sar ON sar.AREA_CODE = SUBSTR(w.STATION_CODE, 1, 16) LEFT JOIN POS_STATION_MARK m ON m.STATION_CODE = w.STATION_CODE LEFT JOIN DEVICE d ON d.CARD_CODE = p.CARD_CODE AND d.STATUS = 1 WHERE p.CARD_CODE = #{cardCode}
SELECT METRIC, VAL1, VAL2, COLLECTED_AT FROM HEALTH_LATEST WHERE CARD_CODE = #{cardCode}

SELECT SRC, CODE, CATEGORY, VAL_TEXT, OCCURRED_AT, LAST_OCCURRED_AT FROM ALERT_EVENT WHERE CARD_CODE = #{cardCode} AND CATEGORY <> 'OTHER' ORDER BY OCCURRED_AT DESC, ID DESC FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql: SELECT st.STATION_CODE, st.STATION_NAME VENDOR_NAME, m.DISPLAY_NAME, st.AREA_CODE, ar.AREA_NAME, st.RUN_STATUS, m.X, m.Y, m.VERSION, NVL(m.UPDATED_BY, m.PLACED_BY) UPDATED_BY, NVL(m.UPDATED_AT, m.PLACED_AT) UPDATED_AT FROM POS_STATION st LEFT JOIN POS_STATION_MARK m ON m.STATION_CODE = st.STATION_CODE LEFT JOIN POS_AREA ar ON ar.AREA_CODE = st.AREA_CODE
mapper.select: ORDER BY ar.AREA_NAME NULLS LAST, st.AREA_CODE, NVL(m.DISPLAY_NAME, st.STATION_NAME) NULLS LAST, st.STATION_CODE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM POS_STATION WHERE STATION_CODE = #{stationCode}
SELECT STATION_CODE, DISPLAY_NAME, X, Y, VERSION FROM POS_STATION_MARK WHERE STATION_CODE = #{stationCode} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POS_STATION_MARK (STATION_CODE, DISPLAY_NAME, X, Y, PLACED_BY, PLACED_AT, VERSION) VALUES (#{stationCode}, #{displayName}, #{x}, #{y}, #{username}, #{now}, 1)
mapper.update: UPDATE POS_STATION_MARK SET X = #{x}, Y = #{y}, DISPLAY_NAME = #{displayName}, UPDATED_BY = #{username}, UPDATED_AT = #{now}, VERSION = VERSION + 1 WHERE STATION_CODE = #{stationCode} AND VERSION = #{version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM POS_STATION_MARK WHERE STATION_CODE = #{stationCode} AND VERSION = #{version}
mapper.select: SELECT USERNAME FROM SYS_OPERATION_LOG WHERE TARGET_TYPE = 'STATION' AND TARGET_ID = #{stationCode} ORDER BY ID DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT l.ID, l.USERNAME, l.ACTION, l.TARGET_ID, st.STATION_NAME VENDOR_NAME, m.DISPLAY_NAME, ar.AREA_NAME, l.BEFORE_JSON, l.AFTER_JSON, l.CREATED_AT FROM SYS_OPERATION_LOG l LEFT JOIN POS_STATION st ON st.STATION_CODE = l.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN POS_STATION_MARK m ON m.STATION_CODE = l.TARGET_ID LEFT JOIN POS_AREA ar ON ar.AREA_CODE = SUBSTR(l.TARGET_ID, 1, 16)
ORDER BY l.ID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
